api_changes: Recipe.optimizer_convolution=per_offset enables module-aware kernel groups; disabled default preserves old recipes and packets
NormalizedOptimizer records and validates group/channel/layout/kernel-area/version metadata before checkpoint restore
changed_factors: Every kernel group and offset uses exact smoothed polar feedback scaled by sqrt(out_channels/in_channels)/(kernel_height*kernel_width)
Dense, vector and sampled-prior rules, seed0, rates, smoothing, task architectures/laws/budgets/cadence remain fixed
mechanism_rationale: Published Conv2D atomic duality rule with a conservative zero-insertion extension for transposed convolution; opt-in source-bound adaptation, not full modular network composition or a GAN convergence guarantee.
